name: Open a sub-account for a member
description: Sign on to the servicing console, look up a member, open a new sub-account of the requested type with an initial deposit, and return the new account number and confirmation reference from the confirmation screen.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: the member number to open the sub-account for

inputs.name: account_type
inputs.description: the kind of account to open

inputs.name: nickname
inputs.description: a short label for the new account

outputs.name: new_account_number
outputs.description: the new account number shown on the confirmation screen

outcomes.message: No member exists for the supplied member id.
The operator role is not permitted to view this member record.
The application rejected the submitted values.
The host declined the posting; it is temporarily unavailable.
A maintenance notice interrupted the flow.
The application session expired; re-authentication is required.
The application returned an unexpected system error.

provenance.notes: Recorded by walking the flow with a deterministic driver, not by an LLM discovery run: a local 7B could not complete this eleven-step flow (see REPORT.md section 7). The genuine LLM discovery run in this repo is member.savings_balance.lookup. This capability exists to exercise the replay-side guardrails -- risk classification, the approval gate, and validation outcomes.
